title: pentanema asperum
intro: Pentanema asperum, commonly known as the prickly knapweed, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. Pentanema asperum has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its purported benefits in reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
